current_task_binding.dataset_name: GIMMS NDVI From AVHRR Sensors (3rd Generation)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global land coverage at roughly 9 km, including the alpine grassland, meadow, desert-steppe and periglacial surfaces of the Tibetan Plateau in Central Asia.

analytical_capabilities: Multi-decadal vegetation greenness trend analysis spanning the early 1980s onward
Interannual and growing-season vegetation dynamics at regional to continental scale
Maximum-value compositing of sub-monthly observations into monthly or annual series
Comparison of vegetation conditions across elevation belts, climate zones, or vegetation types
Quality-filtered assessment of long-term vegetation variability against gridded climate variables

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the `ndvi` band together with the `qa` flag band to drop unreliable retrievals before compositing. Values are stored without a scale factor, unlike MODIS vegetation-index collections. The coarse cell size means a single pixel mixes land-cover types, so masking sparsely vegetated cells by a low-NDVI threshold is common before trend analysis. Two composites per month allow maximum-value compositing to a monthly step.

current_task_binding.data_source: NASA and NOAA, derived from AVHRR sensors

observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: GIMMS release, archive, grid, resampling or temporal aggregation retaining NDVI3g observations
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: NOAA CDR AVHRR, MODIS, SPOT, PROBA-V or another NDVI production lineage without GIMMS input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: GIMMS NDVI3g from AVHRR sensors is admitted; MODIS MOD13/MYD13 tiers, SPOT VEGETATION, PROBA-V and Landsat-derived vegetation indices are excluded.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: This policy defines which product counts as the anchor, not whether a paper may also use other vegetation-index products. A study comparing several sensors is admissible as long as the admitted GIMMS series is itself operationally processed.

anchor_repointed.reason: The admitted product is the long-term AVHRR-based GIMMS NDVI series at roughly 8 km on a 15-day step, not a 250 m 16-day MODIS collection. MODIS also cannot reach back to the early 1980s, so the former anchor could not support a multi-decadal analysis at all.
anchor_repointed.verified_against: Earth Engine catalog entry NASA/GIMMS/3GV0 (status ready, 15-day cadence, 9277 m gsd, ndvi and qa bands, record from 1981-07)
anchor_repointed.residual_gap: The catalog record ends 2013-12-16, whereas the published GIMMS NDVI3g series extends to 2015. Analyses needing the final two years cannot be reproduced from this asset alone.
